pages.title: Enable an Endpoint
pages.text: Start an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions service, such as Ollama, and make sure the selected model is available there.$(br2)Under $(thing)["LLM Config"]$(), the defaults are:$(br)$(thing)llmBaseUrl = "http://localhost:11434/v1/"$()$(br)$(thing)llmModel = "gpt-oss-20b"$()$(br)$(thing)llmKey = "ollama"$()

pages.title: Server-Side Requests
pages.text: Set $(thing)questsUseLLM = true$() under $(thing)["Chaos Generation"]$() and restart before generating quests.$(br2)The base URL must be reachable from the server. Auram appends $(thing)chat/completions$() and sends $(thing)llmKey$() as a Bearer token. Change the model string and key to match your service.

pages.title: Service Availability
pages.text: Generation waits for valid JSON quest text and can retry failed or malformed responses. A missing service or unsuitable model can stall text-enabled generation.$(br2)To generate without a service, leave $(thing)questsUseLLM$() false. Quest text requests include mod descriptions and recipe item names, and hosted services may charge for them.
